tables.title: Bayesian Paired Samples T-Test
notes: Prior: Cauchy on effect size δ with scale r = 0.707.

interpretation.text:
A Bayesian Paired Samples T-Test used a Cauchy prior with scale r = 0.707 on the standardized effect size.

For drug1 − drug2, the data are 17.3 times more likely under H₁ (the measures differ) than under H₀ (no difference): BF₁₀ = 17.3, strong evidence for H₁. The posterior median effect size is δ = −1.09, 95% credible interval [−1.95, −0.28].

title: Bayesian Paired Samples T-Test
code:
library(BayesFactor)
library(ggnext)
# Bayesian paired samples t-test: drug1 vs drug2
d <- subset(data, !is.na(drug1) & !is.na(drug2))
desc <- data.frame(variable = c("drug1", "drug2", "Difference"),
  n = nrow(d),
  mean = c(mean(d$drug1), mean(d$drug2), mean(d$drug1 - d$drug2)),
  sd = c(sd(d$drug1), sd(d$drug2), sd(d$drug1 - d$drug2)))
rscale <- sqrt(2) / 2   # Cauchy prior width on the effect size delta
bf <- ttestBF(x = d$drug1, y = d$drug2, paired = TRUE, rscale = rscale)
bf10 <- extractBF(bf)$bf
set.seed(123)
delta <- as.numeric(posterior(bf, iterations = 10000, progress = FALSE)[, "delta"])
# Prior and posterior density of delta
grid <- seq(min(-2, quantile(delta, 0.001)), max(2, quantile(delta, 0.999)), length.out = 400)
dens <- density(delta)
pp <- rbind(
  data.frame(delta = grid, density = approx(dens$x, dens$y, grid, yleft = 0, yright = 0)$y, Distribution = "Posterior"),
  data.frame(delta = grid, density = dcauchy(grid, 0, rscale), Distribution = "Prior"))
p_pp <- ggnext(pp, aes(delta, density, color = Distribution)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, dash = "4 4") +
  labs(title = "Prior and posterior: drug1 vs drug2", x = "Effect size (δ)", y = "Density") +
  theme_modern()
# Robustness check: the Bayes factor across prior widths
rob <- data.frame(r = seq(0.05, 1.5, by = 0.05))
rob$bf10 <- sapply(rob$r, function(r) extractBF(ttestBF(x = d$drug1, y = d$drug2, paired = TRUE, rscale = r))$bf[1])
rob_user <- data.frame(r = rscale, bf10 = bf10)
p_rob <- ggnext(rob, aes(r, log10(bf10))) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(data = rob_user, size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, dash = "4 4") +
  labs(title = "Bayes factor robustness: drug1 vs drug2", x = "Prior width (r)", y = "log10(BF₁₀)") +
  theme_modern()
